name: Technique - Gun sub and pitch fall
description: Standalone technique from the machine-gun checklist: gritty sine sub, noise, tube drive and a fast falling pitch envelope.

manual.instruction: Use a sine sub at a low octave. Add a little noise and tube distortion so the sub is gritty rather than pure.
manual.verify: The sub has weight and audible grit without losing its fundamental.
manual.why: MOONBOY's gun sub is a gritty sine with noise and tube distortion.

manual.instruction: Add a fast falling pitch envelope. The fall must happen immediately at the hit, not swell in late.
manual.verify: The note starts high and drops into the sub, giving the gun its impact.
manual.why: Code: Pandorum says the sub pitch fall is what separates a machine gun from a static bass.

manual.instruction: Keep the sub mono and check it against the kick. Remove any click layer's low end if it clashes.
manual.verify: The sub is centered and the kick still punches through.
manual.why: Code: Pandorum layers a separate click and removes its low end so it does not fight the sub.

notes: Sources: MOONBOY, 'HOW TO TEAROUT DUBSTEP' (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nApsgDWSQ7Y); Code: Pandorum, 'MACHINE GUN BASS DESIGN' (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sk--QbE_TM0); Wheysted Music, 'SERUM TEAR-OUT GUN BASS TUTORIAL' (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KkXF4T_WPbY); Dripment, '2 TEAROUT Serum 2 BASS ROUTINES' (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NRfK34KZIf8).
